disclaimer: This is an original educational CPU path-traced image that reconstructs the essay's 4 x 5 x 3 m reference room with Lambertian-only materials. It is NOT an Unreal Engine scene, NOT an Unreal Engine capture, and is not a substitute for the user's requested identical Unreal scene. The tall right block's Unreal glossy/metallic BRDF is not reproduced.

scene.description: CPU-lab reconstruction of the essay's 4 x 5 x 3 m room: red wall at x=-2, green wall at x=+2, neutral floor at z=0, ceiling at z=3, back wall at y=5, open front at y=0 with black environment. A 1.3 x 1.2 m emitter at (0,2.7,2.98) emits downward. A short matte block is on the left; the tall right block uses the same placement as the essay's glossy block but a neutral Lambertian albedo, because this renderer has no metallic/GGX lobe.
scene.coordinate_system: CPU-lab metres, x right, y depth (front to back), z up; Unreal centimetres map as (x_u,y_u,z_u)=(-100x,100y,100z)
scene.geometry: five room rectangles (open front) + two axis-aligned boxes; Lambertian two-sided BSDF
scene.units: metres (radiance and emission in arbitrary linear units)

walls.front: open at y=0; rays escape to the black environment

blocks.name: glossy-block-right-lambertian
blocks.note: essay's tall glossy block placement; rendered here as neutral Lambertian only. The Unreal metallic/roughness 0.85/0.12 BRDF is NOT reproduced.

camera.aspect: 1.4 (560x400 essay reference; CPU artifact uses a smaller same-aspect image)

scene.alignment_note: Room dimensions, camera, emitter and block placements are aligned with the essay's CPU lab. This is still a separate educational CPU render with Lambertian-only materials, not an identical Unreal scene, not an Unreal capture, and not a reproduction of the glossy block's Unreal BRDF.

options.mis: power heuristic beta=2 (light vs BSDF strategy)
options.environment: black; the front at y=0 is open
options.outputs: PFM raw linear radiance (bottom-up float32) + 8-bit sRGB PNG
